items.title: Harbour today
items.detail: Harbour Bakery is open · till 743 · counter run alone · Jonas: fisher, cash 18829

items.title: You began a gallery by Anchor Pub
The gallery you began by Anchor Pub was finished
Lise rested on the bench by the harbour
The winter Jonas and Ivo made it up came to an end
Half the harbour ran into the sea for the Year's End Swim, as good as last year, around the net store you made
You moved the bench to Anchor Pub
Mia left you a postcard with a few lines on it
items.detail: To mark the turn of the season, from me to you.
